description: Whether each market is in a bet stop (stop: true when something just happened that can be front-run, e.g. a score) and whether its price is widened. Needs an API key with plan risk.

fixture.description: one fixture id, e.g. nba-261030-mia-cha (from list_fixtures); default all of the league

league.description: one league (mlb, nba, nfl, cfb, nhl, epl, bund, laliga, ucl); default all

name: get_bet_stop_status
